source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
A persisting effect lasts until a set point, such as until your next turn begins. If one applies to a unit as it is placed in **strategic reserves** or embarks in a **TRANSPORT**, note it and its duration; once the unit returns to the battlefield, it applies for its full duration.

A rule with no stated duration:

- that names when it triggers, such as ‘In the Shooting phase’, lasts only for that period, here until that Shooting phase ends
- that is otherwise given to a unit lasts only for the phase it was given in
